test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given options.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Obssess."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The incorrectly spelt word is** "Obssess."** • The correct spelling is **"Obsess."** • It means to completely fill your mind so that you cannot think of anything else. (किसी बात को दिमाग़ में ऐसे भर लेना कि कुछ और न सूझे, किसी बात से मन का पूर्णतया आविष्‍ट या ग्रस्‍त हो जाना) • **Example**: *He became **obsessed**__ with getting his revenge.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Weave: to make cloth, etc. by passing threads under and over a set of threads that is fixed to a frame loom. ((कपड़ा आदि) बुनना, बुनाई करना) • Heave: to lift, pull or throw somebody/something heavy with one big effort. (एक ही सफल प्रयास किसी भारी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऊपर उठाना, खींचना या फेंकना) • Sieve: to put a liquid or powder through a sieve. (छानना (छलनी से)) 37:Taff, The correct answer is **"****Sincerely."**
